note: The 4 cases the course demo must show. The nudge case uses store ST238, whose order history makes Fortune oil a very likely item next week (model probability about 0.92), so leaving oil out should trigger a nudge.

cases.label: 1. Clean order
cases.message: Namaste bhaiya, 2 peti Parle-G 100g, 1 peti Maggi aur 5 packet Tata Salt 1kg bhej do
cases.expect: All 3 items matched; no follow-up; confirmation table with rupee totals.

cases.label: 2. Unclear order (follow-up)
cases.message: bhaiya 3 dabba parle aur 2 peti oil bhejna
cases.expect: Two follow-ups: Parle-G 50g or 100g? and which oil (Fortune / Saffola / Dhara)?

cases.label: 3. Reorder nudge
cases.message: 2 peti hide and seek aur 1 dabba MDH mirch bhej do
cases.expect: Both items matched; nudge: 'Aapne is baar Fortune oil order nahi kiya, bhej dein?' with Yes/No.

cases.label: 4. Item not in catalog
cases.message: 1 peti good day aur 2 box Ferrero Rocher bhej do
cases.expect: Good Day matched; Ferrero Rocher shown as 'Not in catalog', never replaced with another product.
